headline: PromoGrind's product layer is mature; the highest-leverage work is making Studio OS truth surfaces current, coherent, and impossible to misread.

items.title: Fix SIL forecast parser so startup no longer predicts a false 0/1000
items.why: The startup brief is the sole source of session context, so a false SIL forecast can steer the whole session in the wrong direction. The live code parsed totals but missed the actual category-table shape, making a healthy project look like a collapse.
items.evidence: Verified by `node scripts/lib/sil-forecaster.mjs --json`: forecast now returns category predictions and totalPredicted 995 instead of 0.
items.recipe: Support both numbered and unnumbered SIL category table rows; normalize category aliases to the canonical SIL v3 names; ignore table headers and non-category rows.

L1.recipe: Patch row regex to parse the current table.

L2.recipe: Patch regex plus canonical category alias filtering.

L3.recipe: Move SIL category names and parser fixtures into a shared test harness.

items.title: Make closeout board show the canonical live PromoGrind URL
items.why: The closeout board added a live-link surface but skipped `PROJECT_STATUS.liveUrl`, which is PromoGrind's authoritative URL in this public repo. A closeout surface that hides the live product slows launch verification and contradicts the public-facing project requirements.
items.evidence: Verified by `node scripts/render-closeout-board.mjs --stdout`: SESSION CLOSEOUT now includes `Live: preview -> https://promogrind.bet`.
items.recipe: Include `status.liveUrl` and `status.deployedUrl` in `canonicalLiveUrl()` before registry fallbacks.

L1.recipe: Add `status.liveUrl` to the URL candidate list.

L2.recipe: Also add `status.deployedUrl` and verify board output.

L3.recipe: Add a fixture-backed validator asserting every public-* project closeout board includes a URL when one exists.

items.title: Lock startup brief coherence and tile budgets into the validator
items.why: The brief is deliberately token-lean, but without per-tile attribution the next bloat regression becomes a generic size complaint instead of an actionable fix. Coherence stamping also prevents stale SIL/session disagreement from becoming a silent planning surface.
items.evidence: Verified by `node scripts/test-validate-brief-format.mjs` and `node scripts/validate-brief-format.mjs docs/STARTUP_BRIEF.md --json`: canonical brief passes, size is 11102 bytes, budget status pass.
items.recipe: Keep `brief-coherent` enforcement, per-tile budgets, and top-block reporting wired into `validate-brief-format.mjs`; regenerate the brief after parser fixes.

L3.recipe: Add golden brief fixtures and budget trend graphing by tile.

items.title: Centralize doctor warning/failure predicates and provenance ownership
items.why: Doctor surfaces previously risked counting yellow warnings and red failures with divergent inline predicates. Canonical predicates plus provenance classification keep human-blocker pressure honest and prevent sibling-owned adoption work from being misread as local debt.
items.evidence: Verified by `node scripts/classify-warning-provenance.mjs --json`: provenance map is healthy with no violations; doctor writes 10/12 with two advisory stale intelligence signals.
items.recipe: Use `scripts/lib/doctor-predicates.mjs` wherever warning/failure status is tallied; keep `classify-warning-provenance.mjs` as the owner map validator.

L2.recipe: Wire provenance validation and startup ownership split.

L3.recipe: Add an automated drift scanner that rejects new inline doctor predicates.

items.title: Refresh stale revenue and IGNIS intelligence after this truth-surface pass
items.why: Doctor now honestly reports only two remaining advisory drifts: revenue signals and IGNIS freshness. Those are derived intelligence surfaces, not implementation blockers, but closeout should preserve them as the next best cleanup task.
items.evidence: `node scripts/ops.mjs doctor --update-json` reports 10/12 passing with stale revenue signals and stale IGNIS as advisory drift.
items.recipe: Run the repo-local revenue and IGNIS refresh commands when credentials/tooling are available; if missing, log the exact script/tool absence and keep them advisory.

L1.recipe: Document the stale advisory signals in closeout.

L2.recipe: Run `node scripts/ops.mjs revenue-signals` and the local IGNIS refresh path.

L3.recipe: Automate stale derived-surface refresh when doctor marks them advisory.
